end.summary:
Discussed how family members share household work and care for one another.
Trisha named Mummy, Papa, and Dadi as family members who help.
Trisha said she regularly puts shoes in the shoe rack.
Trisha repeatedly said children are too small to help; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised that household work can be shared by everyone in a family. Trisha identified putting shoes in the shoe rack as something they do regularly, but the idea that children can help was still mixed up and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small daily task, such as arranging shoes, and talk about how it helps the family.
